title: Create job postings using customizable templates
i_want: to use customizable job posting templates
so_that: I can quickly create job listings
acceptance_criteria: System must provide ≥ 5 templates
System must have dynamic fields
System must comply with F-01

title: Automatically post job listings to multiple channels
i_want: to automatically post job listings to multiple channels
so_that: I can save time and ensure wide reach
acceptance_criteria: System must support 1-click posting on ≥ 4 channels
System must automatically post to LinkedIn, Indeed, Welcome to the Jungle, and careers website
System must comply with F-02

title: Generate a unique application URL for each job posting
i_want: to generate a unique application URL for each job posting
so_that: I can track the source of applications
acceptance_criteria: System must generate a dedicated application URL per job posting
System must track the source of applications
System must comply with F-03

title: Moderate job postings before publication
i_want: to moderate job postings before they are published
so_that: I can ensure job postings meet quality standards
acceptance_criteria: System must have an HR + Manager validation workflow
System must require moderation before job posting publication
System must comply with F-04

title: Automatically parse candidate CVs
i_want: to automatically parse candidate CVs
so_that: I can save time and improve efficiency
acceptance_criteria: System must recognize ≥ 90% of standard CVs
System must support parsing of PDF, Word, and LinkedIn CVs
System must comply with F-05

title: Store structured candidate CV data
i_want: to store structured candidate CV data
so_that: I can easily search and filter candidates
acceptance_criteria: System must store candidate CV data in a structured database
System must support full-text search by skills, experience, and location
System must comply with F-06

title: Score candidates based on job description
i_want: to score candidates based on job description
so_that: I can prioritize candidates
acceptance_criteria: System must use a transparent algorithm to score candidates
System must allow customizable scoring criteria
System must comply with F-07

title: Detect duplicate candidate applications
i_want: to detect duplicate candidate applications
so_that: I can avoid processing the same candidate multiple times
acceptance_criteria: System must alert if email or first+last name is identical
System must detect applications from the same candidate for different positions
System must comply with F-08

title: Recruitment Coordinator
i_want: to ensure the configuration environment is set up correctly
so_that: to facilitate smooth user acceptance testing
acceptance_criteria: System must log all configuration changes made by the coordinator (F-07)
System must notify the coordinator when the environment is ready for UAT (F-08)
System must track the status of tested flows during UAT (F-09)

title: Candidate
i_want: to receive training on the new ATS system
so_that: to be able to use the system effectively
acceptance_criteria: System must provide training sessions for candidates (F-10)
System must document the training sessions attended by candidates (F-11)
System must ensure candidates have access to user guides (F-12)

title: HR Manager
i_want: to ensure the project stays within budget
so_that: to manage financial resources effectively
acceptance_criteria: System must track the estimated budget for the project (F-13)
System must log all expenses against the budget (F-14)
System must generate budget variance reports (F-15)

title: Hiring Manager
i_want: to receive signed acceptance reports
so_that: to confirm the project is completed as per requirements
acceptance_criteria: System must generate signed acceptance reports for the project (F-16)
System must notify the hiring manager when the reports are ready (F-17)
System must archive the signed reports for future reference (F-18)

title: Customizable steps per job type
i_want: the ability to configure multiple steps in the recruitment process
so_that: I can tailor the hiring process to different job roles
acceptance_criteria: ≥ 5 configurable steps (e.g., CV → Phone Screen → Tech Interview → Manager Interview → Offer)
System must comply with F-10
System must allow for real-time updates

title: Comments and evaluations per step
i_want: to be able to leave comments and evaluations at each step of the recruitment process
so_that: I can document the candidate's progress and provide feedback
acceptance_criteria: Complete history, non-modifiable
System must comply with F-12
System must ensure comments are non-editable

title: Customizable automatic emails
i_want: to be able to customize automated emails for different stages of the recruitment process
so_that: I can ensure candidates receive timely and relevant communications
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic variables (first name, position, delay)
System must comply with F-14
System must allow for dynamic content insertion

title: Push and email notifications (configurable)
i_want: to be able to configure push and email notifications for various events in the recruitment process
so_that: I can keep all stakeholders informed in real-time
acceptance_criteria: Per-user configuration
System must comply with F-17
System must allow for customizable notification settings

title: Interview scheduling with calendar integration
i_want: to be able to schedule interviews using integrated calendars
so_that: I can manage the scheduling process more efficiently
acceptance_criteria: Bi-directional sync, timezone management
System must comply with F-15
System must allow for calendar integration

title: Configure job-specific recruitment steps
i_want: to set up a minimum of five configurable steps for each job type
so_that: I can streamline the hiring process for different roles
acceptance_criteria: System must allow for at least 5 steps to be configured per job type (F-10)
Steps must include options for CV review, phone screen, technical interview, manager interview, and offer (F-10)
Configured steps must be saved and applied consistently across all job postings (F-10)

title: Ensure secure handling of candidate attachments
i_want: to ensure that all candidate attachments are encrypted and access-controlled
so_that: to protect sensitive information during the hiring process
acceptance_criteria: System must use AES-256 encryption for all candidate attachments (F-09)
Access to candidate attachments must be restricted to authorized personnel only (F-09)
Encryption and access controls must be enforced at all times (F-09)

title: Implement real-time candidate movement tracking
i_want: to be able to move candidates between recruitment steps with a drag-and-drop interface
so_that: to efficiently manage the hiring process
acceptance_criteria: System must provide an intuitive interface for moving candidates between steps (F-11)
Candidate movement must be reflected in real-time across all relevant screens (F-11)
Real-time updates must be visible to all team members with access to the candidate's profile (F-11)
